_crons_disabled_note: Cron removed after the Supabase egress quota was exhausted and the platform went offline. Nothing calls the agent automatically now: this crons array is empty, the GitHub Actions schedule in .github/workflows/cron.yml is commented out (workflow_dispatch only), the queue worker is opt-in (AGENT_WORKER=1), and the console no longer polls. Underneath all of that, src/db/supabase.ts now fails closed: the agent makes no Supabase request at all unless AGENT_DB=on. Deleting the keys would NOT have done this - config.ts defaults missing vars to '' and never exits, so requests still fire and 401. To run work: set AGENT_DB=on, then POST /agent/cron/tick. Restore this block only once the egress source is confirmed in Reports > Usage.
